headline: The headline that got it wrong
post_facts: A strike forced an early press run

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen forty-eight... a Chicago paper printed a headline it could never take back.

scenes.label: Thomas E. Dewey
scenes.caption: Republican nominee, 1948
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] A strike forced an early deadline, and the polls favored Thomas Dewey.

scenes.label: copies printed with the wrong headline
scenes.text: [calmly] About one hundred fifty thousand copies read... Dewey Defeats Truman.

scenes.label: St. Louis Union Station
scenes.caption: President Truman holds up the paper
scenes.text: [softly] But Harry Truman had won. In St. Louis, he held the paper up for the cameras.

scenes.title: Have you seen this famous photo?
scenes.text: [gently] Have you ever seen this famous photo?
